notes: `בָּחֳלָיִים` is preposition plus noun with no article morpheme segmented; the `בְּ` is the clause's predicate and carries the recast *shalt have* with its modal, under rules 43 and 49, while the noun keeps *sickness*. The competing reading takes *shalt have* as rule 20's construction-supplied copula on `חֳלָיִים`; it was set aside because rule 43 assigns a *have* to the morpheme that makes the clause possessive and the subtraction test leaves the preposition's relation unstated without it.

Both `מֵעִים` occurrences and both `יָמִים` occurrences are separately rendered, so nothing is left unrendered and rule 22's unrepresented-occurrence sentence does not arise; the `עַל` takes the distributive *by* standing between the members.
The ASV marginal note *Or, year after year* was read and set aside (rule 38).
